concerns.location: plan.md:FR-004 / SC-002 coverage rows; Phase 2 eval_runner
concerns.text: SC-002 requires ≥10% improvement over the composition baseline for Young's/shear (relative MAPE reduction) AND Poisson's ratio via MAE. The plan and results_schema.yaml define relative_mape_reduction only for young/shear; no plan element computes or gates a Poisson MAE improvement vs the baseline. Add a Poisson MAE relative-reduction (or equivalent) metric and gate in eval_runner.py / results_schema.
